claims.answer: Product-created supervisor agents watch an assigned quest group. Sidequest itself manages queue promotion; the supervisor agent inspects/answers workers and escalates risky decisions. A supervisor can create quests through the product CLI in its group; queued quests start when the product watcher frees a slot. This is not unrestricted delegation to other supervisor groups. quest read/status/send provide live terminal inspection and targeted text/menu replies. Supervisor read/send is restricted to itself and its reporting supervisors. Supervisor notes/status tables retain actions, while Saga quest steps can wait for a structured sidequest saga report result. These are distinct result paths, not proof of a universal artifact gallery.

sources.title: Sidequest readme
sources.finding: Documents downloadable macOS/Linux app and parallel Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI and OpenCode quests.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-getting-started-setup-mdx
sources.locator: Agents table; Welcome Bot; What Sidequest installs
sources.finding: Documents actual agent executables, own login prerequisites, tmux/Git requirements, product CLI installation and account-specific directories.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-agents-and-models-mdx
sources.locator: Supported agents table; Codex permissions; What only works with Claude; profiles
sources.finding: Exact launch binaries/flags and feature limitations are documented. Codex defaults to bypassing approvals/sandbox; supervisors run unsandboxed; agents retain their own authentication.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-quest-types-mdx
sources.finding: Worktree quests get branches and separate checkouts, Current Branch quests share the existing directory, and Review quests fetch a PR head into a worktree.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-supervisors-mdx
sources.locator: What a supervisor does; Rules; Starting/stopping; Reporting lines
sources.finding: Product supervisors can read/send to their own quest group, answer routine prompts and create child work through CLI; the product watcher pulls queue slots. Risky merges/main operations escalate to the user.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-advanced-cli-mdx
sources.locator: quest create/status/read/send; supervisors; Inside a supervisor session lines 284-302
sources.finding: Product-owned CLI talks to local app socket, creates/activates tasks and supervises live terminals. Supervisor scope limits creation/messages to its own group, and refuses management of unrelated supervisors.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-advanced-remote-machines-mdx
sources.finding: Named remote templates support SSH, one Docker container per quest, devpod or Coder workspaces. The target must have git/tmux/logged-in coding CLI; stock Docker preset needs a suitable image.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-reference-faq-mdx
sources.locator: Does anything leave; data stored; worktrees; completed quests; supervisor permissions
sources.finding: Docs say no accounts or telemetry and describe local SQLite state, retained worktrees/tmux sessions and configurable completed-quest retention. Supervisor command scope is explicitly not a sandbox.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-github-mdx
sources.locator: Opening paragraph; Issues browser; Review quests; Opening PRs
sources.finding: GitHub integration uses gh, imports issue prompts and shows PR state. It explicitly never creates or merges PRs itself; an agent runs gh pr create on request.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-sagas-mdx
sources.locator: Start triggers; schedules; run inspection; Result
sources.finding: Product workflow graphs run manually, on schedules or new PR/issues. Schedules are checked once a minute in the app; missed schedules run once after close/sleep and overlapping scheduled runs are passed over. Agents can report structured Saga results.

sources.title: Sidequest src-content-docs-docs-guides-changes-panel-mdx
sources.locator: Layout; Comment on lines; Find in diff
sources.finding: The docs precisely describe a quest Changes panel with actual unified/side-by-side/hunk code, line comments and find. No populated diff screenshot or public implementation for its renderer was established in this pass.

sources.title: Sidequest license
sources.locator: Sidequest Proprietary License, opening grant and clauses 1-3
sources.finding: Software license permits personal non-commercial use only; redistribution, modification/reverse engineering and commercial use without permission are restricted.

sources.title: Sidequest tools-screenshots-ui-harness-site-app-tsx
sources.locator: Opening comment and imports; synthetic fixture/shim initialization
sources.finding: The vendor screenshot harness imports the real Sidequest App and its actual settings/theme components with fake bridge data and transcript fixtures. This supports authentic UI with sample data, not a live agent execution.
